hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -q 'clasp push' || exit 0; git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" show --name-only --pretty=format: HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE 'dashboard\.html|code\.js' || exit 0; msg=$(cat "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/gas-push-checklist.txt" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$msg" ] || exit 0; jq -n --arg c "$msg" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",additionalContext:$c}}'

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; input=$(cat); active=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false' 2>/dev/null); [ "$active" = "true" ] && exit 0; tp=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); sid=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.session_id // "nosession"' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$tp" ] && [ -f "$tp" ] || exit 0; cur=$(wc -c < "$tp" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' '); [ -n "$cur" ] || exit 0; marker="/tmp/automem-learnings-${sid}"; last=$(cat "$marker" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); [ $((cur - last)) -ge 150000 ] || exit 0; if [ -f "$marker" ] && [ -n "$(find "$marker" -mmin -30 2>/dev/null)" ]; then exit 0; fi; echo "$cur" > "$marker"; prompt=$(cat "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/learnings-capture-prompt.txt" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$prompt" ] || exit 0; gitprompt=$(cat "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/git-commit-checkpoint-prompt.txt" 2>/dev/null); target="LEARNINGS.d/${sid}.md"; jq -n --arg r "$prompt" --arg g "$gitprompt" --arg t "$target" '{decision:"block", reason:($r + "  Write ONLY to " + $t + " (your own session file; create it if absent). Never edit LEARNINGS.md or any other session file; that is the write race.  " + $g)}'
